name: Adzviser AdRoll
description:
Connect your AdRoll data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about impressions, clicks, spend, and conversions. Compare campaigns, dig into ad group and creative performance, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's results or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser AdRoll to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser AdRoll to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://adroll.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser AdRoll MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser AdRoll provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_adroll, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser AdRoll?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser AdRoll in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser AdRoll MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser AdRoll requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser AdRoll is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
